symptom: Swing Acceleration Performance is Unsatisfactory or Swing Speed is Slow in Only One Direction
detail_of_failure: Swing acceleration performance is unsatisfactory or swing speed is low in only one direction.
related_information: Pre-troubleshooting If a failure code is shown, do the troubleshooting for that code first. Monitoring code • The swing LEFT PPC pressure can be examined with the monitoring function. (Code: 09001) • The swing RIGHT PPC pressure can be examined with the monitoring function. (Code: 09002)

branches.YES: Go to the check item of “Swing control valve”.
branches.NO: Go to the check item of “Pressure compensation valve on swing RIGHT side of swing control valve”.

steps.procedure: 1. Release the pressure that remains in the hydraulic tank and piping to do the troubleshooting. For details, see Testing and Adjusting, “Release Remained Pressure in Hydraulic Circuit”. 2. Examine the control valve body and the swing spool to see if they are not twisted or stuck and that they do not have any damage or dirt on them. (They must move smoothly and not be stuck.) REMARK Be careful that dirt does not enter during recovery work.

branches.YES: • The swing control valve body and spool are correct. • Go to the next check item.
branches.NO: • The swing control valve body and spool are defective. • Replace the body and spool of the swing control valve. • Go to “Confirmation of repair”.

steps.cause: Pressure compensation valve on swing RIGHT side of swing control valve
steps.procedure: 1. Release the pressure that remains in the hydraulic tank and piping. For details, see Testing and Adjusting, “Release Remained Pressure in Hydraulic Circuit”. 2. Interchange the right and left pressure compensation valves of the swing control valve. 3. Is there no change, and does the phenomenon reproduce?

branches.YES: • Pressure compensation valve on right side of swing control valve is normal. • Go to the next check item.
branches.NO: • The right pressure compensation valve of the swing control valve is defective. • Replace the right pressure compensation valve of the swing control valve. • Go to “Confirmation of repair”.
